tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: The ground behind everything: the window background around the chat sheet and panels.

tokens.name: chrome
tokens.usage: Top bar, panel tabs and button hover. Sits between bg and sheet.

tokens.name: sheet
tokens.usage: The raised main surface: the chat sheet, cards, docks, default buttons. Most text lives on sheet.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Inputs: the composer, text fields, code blocks, the active panel tab.

tokens.name: chip
tokens.usage: Chips, soft accent backgrounds and selected rows in inspectors.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Progress tracks and slider rails; the unfilled part of a meter.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Default 1px borders on buttons, fields, panels and dividers.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet dividers inside a surface (list rows, table rules).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, chrome, sheet and field (≈16:1).

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, tab text, supporting copy on sheet and chrome.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Muted text: metadata, timestamps, placeholders, glosses. Still ≥4.5:1 on sheet and bg in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-on-fill
tokens.usage: Text on interaction-fill and danger-fill (primary and destructive buttons).

tokens.name: bubble-partner-bg
tokens.usage: The conversation partner's message bubble. Warm: the partner's side of the chat is warm.

tokens.name: bubble-partner-line
tokens.usage: 1px border of the partner's bubble.

tokens.name: bubble-learner-bg
tokens.usage: The learner's own message bubble. Cool: your side of the chat is cool.

tokens.name: bubble-learner-line
tokens.usage: 1px border of the learner's bubble.

tokens.name: interaction-ink
tokens.usage: THE accent. Links, active tab text, selected states, focus rings, XP numbers. Text on sheet, field and chip.

tokens.name: interaction-fill
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, with ink-on-fill text. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: interaction-fill-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover (source name: accent-strong-hover).

tokens.name: interaction-tint
tokens.usage: A faint accent wash behind selected chips, key tokens and held words.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: The one keyboard focus outline: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every interactive element. Alias of interaction-ink.

tokens.name: success-ink
tokens.usage: Success: confirmed revisions, earned credit, completed work. Text on sheet and on success-tint.

tokens.name: success-line
tokens.usage: Borders and marks for success: succeeded AI steps, timeline bars.

tokens.name: success-tint
tokens.usage: Background behind success-ink.

tokens.name: warning-ink
tokens.usage: Warning: things that need attention, and corrections the coach suggests. Text on sheet and warning-tint.

tokens.name: warning-line
tokens.usage: Border and underline for warnings and corrections.

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Background behind warning-ink.

tokens.name: danger-ink
tokens.usage: Errors, 'wrong' judgments and destructive-action text. Text on sheet and danger-tint.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Background behind danger-ink: error notices, failed nodes.

tokens.name: danger-line
tokens.usage: Borders and outlines for errors and destructive buttons (3:1 on sheet in both themes).

tokens.name: danger-fill
tokens.usage: Destructive button fill (delete, reset) with ink-on-fill.

tokens.name: danger-fill-hover
tokens.usage: Destructive button hover.

tokens.name: fault-bar-bg
tokens.usage: The application fault bar: dark red in every theme.

tokens.name: fault-bar-line
tokens.usage: Fault bar bottom border.

tokens.name: fault-bar-ink
tokens.usage: Text on fault-bar-bg.

tokens.name: fault-bar-strong
tokens.usage: Emphasis on fault-bar-bg.

tokens.name: mode-review-ink
tokens.usage: Review mode's navigation colour; a mode, not a judgment (same value as success-ink today).

tokens.name: d-social
tokens.usage: Skill domain: Social. Map nodes, domain bars and dots. A fill, not a text color: white on it is only ≈2.6:1 in light — use di-social for text.

tokens.name: di-social
tokens.usage: Skill domain Social as text on sheet.

tokens.name: d-questions
tokens.usage: Skill domain: Questions. Fill for marks; use di-questions for text.

tokens.name: di-questions
tokens.usage: Skill domain Questions as text on sheet.

tokens.name: d-opinions
tokens.usage: Skill domain: Opinions. Fill for marks; use di-opinions for text.

tokens.name: di-opinions
tokens.usage: Skill domain Opinions as text on sheet.

tokens.name: d-statements
tokens.usage: Skill domain: Statements. Fill for marks; use di-statements for text.

tokens.name: di-statements
tokens.usage: Skill domain Statements as text on sheet.

tokens.name: d-descriptions
tokens.usage: Skill domain: Descriptions. Fill for marks; use di-descriptions for text.

tokens.name: di-descriptions
tokens.usage: Skill domain Descriptions as text on sheet.

tokens.name: d-situating
tokens.usage: Skill domain: Situating. Fill for marks; use di-situating for text.

tokens.name: di-situating
tokens.usage: Skill domain Situating as text on sheet.

tokens.name: spectrogram-low
tokens.usage: Recording spectrum: quiet energy.

tokens.name: spectrogram-mid
tokens.usage: Recording spectrum: mid energy.

tokens.name: spectrogram-high
tokens.usage: Recording spectrum: loud energy.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind dialogs. Set by the depth preference (lighter when flat, darker when raised).

tokens.name: scrim-strong
tokens.usage: Behind drawers and destructive confirmations.

families.sans: 'Skelly Arabic Reading', 'Noto Sans Arabic', 'Noto Sans Devanagari', 'Noto Sans Malayalam', 'Noto Sans SC', 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Noto Sans', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif
families.serif: 'Skelly Arabic Reading', 'Noto Sans Arabic', 'Noto Sans Devanagari', 'Noto Sans Malayalam', 'Noto Sans SC', 'Newsreader', 'Noto Sans', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif
families.mono: 'Skelly Arabic Reading', 'Noto Sans Arabic', 'Noto Sans Devanagari', 'Noto Sans Malayalam', 'Noto Sans SC', 'IBM Plex Mono', 'Noto Sans', ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', Consolas, monospace

styles.name: type-hero
styles.usage: The one big heading on a start or empty screen.

styles.name: type-display
styles.usage: Page and dialog titles. Drops to 21px under 860px wide.

styles.name: type-title
styles.usage: Section and card titles. Drops to 16px under 860px wide.

styles.name: type-body
styles.usage: Default UI copy, partner messages, coach remarks.
styles.sample: No reviewed replies for this skill yet. Missing evidence is not a failure.

styles.name: type-ui
styles.usage: Buttons, tabs, form labels, menus — the working size of controls.

styles.name: type-meta
styles.usage: Timestamps, tags, counts. Often set in mono.

styles.name: type-reading
styles.usage: Target-language text the learner reads and writes; the learner's own bubble is serif. Multiplied by --reading-scale and --script-scale at runtime; 17px under 860px wide.

styles.name: mono-meta
styles.usage: Numbers, model names, IDs and inspection tables.

styles.name: mono-ui
styles.usage: Code and YAML blocks in inspectors.

spacing.note: Base values. The app multiplies every step by --layout-scale (tight .75 by default; extra_tight .5, balanced 1, roomy 1.25) so all steps shrink or grow together.

tokens.name: space-hairline
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps; never scaled.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text nudge, tab gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight gaps inside chips and lists.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between paragraphs in coach remarks.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding; message bubble vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Bubble side padding, tiny-button side padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Chat message side padding.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap inside compact cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Button side padding; panel tab bar side padding.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Between groups in a panel.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: List indents; section gaps.

tokens.name: space-11
tokens.usage: Between cards.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between major regions.

tokens.name: space-13
tokens.usage: Page-level breathing room.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Tags, tiny badges.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Panel tabs (top corners), small icon buttons, code blocks, the 'tail' corner of a chat bubble.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and fields.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and inspectors.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Chat bubbles (with one radius-sm tail corner), the composer frame, dialogs and sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills, toggles, XP chips.

shadow.note: Depth is a learner preference (flat / default / raised / recessed); it overrides shadow-surface, shadow-floating and shadow-input. These are the default values.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Small lifts: chat bubbles, cards, the active coach tab.

tokens.name: shadow-surface
tokens.usage: The chat sheet lifting off bg. Follows the depth preference.

tokens.name: shadow-floating
tokens.usage: Dialogs, popovers and reward cards. Follows the depth preference.

tokens.name: shadow-menu
tokens.usage: Menus and pickers.

tokens.name: shadow-drawer
tokens.usage: Side drawers.

tokens.name: shadow-input
tokens.usage: Inset on fields. Follows the depth preference.

tokens.name: shadow-recessed
tokens.usage: Surfaces sunk below the ground: the coach pane, the skill inspector.

control.note: Control metrics. Coarse pointers (touch) always get touch-target.

tokens.name: control-height-xs
tokens.usage: Extra-small icon buttons.

tokens.name: control-height-sm
tokens.usage: Small controls, compact density (32px at standard density).

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs, compact density (40px at standard density).

tokens.name: control-height-lg
tokens.usage: Large buttons.

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum control size on touch screens.

tokens.name: measure-thread
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the conversation thread.
